items.question: What is content restructuring for AIO?
items.answer: AIO means AI Optimization. Buzznerd restructures your dealership pages — headings, structure, descriptions, and formatting — so content is easy for buyers to read, easy for search engines to rank, and easy for AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI to understand and cite.

items.question: Which pages does Buzznerd restructure?
items.answer: Buzznerd restructures the pages that earn business — sales, service, parts, inventory, location, finance, department, campaign, and landing pages.

items.question: Do I have to rewrite everything myself?
items.answer: No. Buzznerd's team audits, rewrites, and restructures your pages for you, so your staff stays focused on selling while your content gets stronger.

items.question: How is this different from normal SEO?
items.answer: Traditional SEO focuses on ranking in search. Content restructuring for AIO makes pages perform everywhere at once — readable for buyers, structured for search engines, and clear enough for AI platforms to recommend your dealership.

items.question: Will restructuring help me show up in AI answers?
items.answer: Yes. Clean structure, clear headings, and well-organized descriptions make it far more likely that AI answer engines understand your pages and name your dealership when buyers ask. You can also check where you stand with a free AI Presence Score.
